content.title: Departure Readiness | Micro-Checks Accumulate into Operational Proof
content.summary: First establish the vehicle and operator, then use multiple partial inspection shots to prove the readiness one by one; a clear activation converts static components into linked motion, and finally use a long-distance departure to prove that the entire system has been put into use.

quick_start.input_format: Original operator and vehicle + at least 3 different preparation checks + 1 explicit activation + at least 2 component linkage + wide-angle continuous departure proof
quick_start.recommended_input: The pollen technician checked the wind vane, seed drum lock and magnetic foot plate in order in the orbital greenhouse, and only activated the inspection vehicle once; after linking the wheel well with the seed drum, it started along the glass track and ended at a high and wide angle passing through two sections of planting cabins.
required_anchors: Establish one operator and one inactive carrier in a shared frame.
Give each close insert a different readiness job rather than repeating beauty details.
After activation, show at least two components responding in the same causal direction.
End with sustained travel in a wider spatial proof, not another static close-up.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First establish the vehicle and operator, then use multiple partial inspection shots to prove the readiness one by one; a clear activation converts static components into linked motion, and finally use a long-distance departure to prove that the entire system has been put into use.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: A readiness-to-departure sequence works as a causal proof ladder: establish one operator-carrier pair, isolate several different readiness checks, trigger one visible activation, show components responding together, then leave enough wide travel evidence to prove the carrier has entered service.

invariants.rule: Establish one operator and one inactive carrier in a shared frame.
invariants.purpose: Creates a stable identity baseline before detail coverage.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later inserts can look like unrelated machines.

invariants.rule: Give each close insert a different readiness job rather than repeating beauty details.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated decorative close-ups do not prove increasing readiness.

invariants.rule: Use one decisive visible activation cue that changes the carrier state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a state change the sequence remains a showroom montage.

invariants.rule: After activation, show at least two components responding in the same causal direction.
invariants.ablation_failure: A single glowing part does not prove system operation.

invariants.rule: End with sustained travel in a wider spatial proof, not another static close-up.
invariants.purpose: Confirms deployment and gives the ladder a physical result.
invariants.ablation_failure: A final detail shot leaves departure unproven.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source wheel and hand insert order

instantiations.concept: In a bright orbital greenhouse, a single pollen technician checks a compact rail skimmer: pressure vane, seed-drum latch and magnetic footplate. A green status ribbon ignites, three assemblies engage, and the skimmer departs along a suspended glass rail while a high wide shot proves continuous travel.
